statement: Paying this invoice is not safe and correct because the invoice record shows it was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, so it must be placed on hold.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the payment must not proceed, stating "it was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, so it must be placed on hold," identifying the specific contradiction in the record.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
